verdict.rationale: Bolna's workflow feature lets users build multi-step outreach sequences (voice calls, WhatsApp, API calls, waits, retries) driven entirely through the API, and the CLI/API support batch call management, both of which enable autonomous, background-running automations once configured (bolna-docs-12, bolna-docs-16, bolna-docs-24). However, evidence is limited to a single doc mention of workflows with no detail on scheduling/triggers, monitoring of long-running automations, or independent confirmation that these run unattended reliably. Missing for 10: scheduling/trigger mechanisms, independent/hands-on verification of autonomous execution, and more depth on workflow monitoring/error handling.
